summary: Iteration_5 tests all new features: address+phone update everywhere, public contact form + admin messages endpoints, shadcn Calendar DateTimePicker on Create Auction, and models.py extraction. Backend 26/26 pytest pass (22 previous + 4 new contact-form tests). Frontend: About Address tab shows new Odisha address + updated Google Maps link/iframe; Contact tab shows +91 82606 65966 as clickable tel link and old phone numbers are absent; footer shows the new Athmallik address + MADE IN ODISHA + tel:+918260665966; contact form submits and shows success card; Admin Messages tab renders submitted messages and mark-read button works; DateTimePicker components present (no native datetime-local remaining), calendar popovers open, picking a day updates trigger label, End-before-Start friendly error 'End time must be after start time.' is displayed, and full end-to-end publish succeeded with the new pickers redirecting to /auctions/<id>.
critical_code_review_comments: models.py extraction is clean; server.py imports are grouped correctly and Pydantic constraints (min_length on ContactInput, min_length=1 on AuctionInput.images) match the acceptance criteria.

POST /api/contact is public (no auth), correctly stores in db.contact_submissions with read=false + ISO created_at; GET/POST /api/admin/contact* both require get_current_admin — verified 401/403 for non-admin.
DateTimePicker forwards data-testid triggers/calendar/time correctly; radix Popover portal is rendered under [role='dialog'] so tests can locate day buttons page-wide.
CreateAuction.jsx applies both future-only + end>start guards in submit handler before hitting the API — friendly inline error text matches the review request verbatim.
Layout.jsx footer mono block is on two lines exactly as specified; tel:+918260665966 anchor is present in footer AND Contact tab.
About.jsx Google Maps external link + embedded iframe both point at Charigharia+Sahi+Athmallik+Angul+Odisha+759125 — consistent with the new address.
Minor: no rate limiting on POST /api/contact — public endpoint could be spammed. Consider adding a per-email or per-IP throttle if abuse becomes an issue (not blocking).
